snippet_primary: "I contacted Patreon Support regarding a refund for an item that was not delivered. Under their own Refund Policy ('item not received' / 'product mismatch'), my case should have qualified. Agent Sam handled my ticket: the response was rude, dismissive, and unhelpful. My refund was denied without any clear, clause-specific explanation, and I was told the decision was final with no further communication. As an EU customer, I find this very concerning and not in line with expected consumer protections. Due to this experience, I have cancelled all my subscriptions and will be using alternative platforms instead."
